record.question: "What so amazing about Grace" is written by
record.explanation: Answer A: Philip Yancey. The identifiable book is Philip Yancey’s What’s So Amazing About Grace?, first published in 1997. The publisher’s own revised-edition copyright/title pages name Philip D. Yancey and retain the 1997 copyright. The printed title What so amazing about Grace is grammatically malformed, but the author among these choices is unambiguous. Historical/source note: The printed title is preserved. Correct bibliographic title: What’s So Amazing About Grace? Later revised-edition front matter is used to establish the stable authorship of the 1997 work. Reference: https://cr-assets.localretailconnect.com/preview/9780310367802.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
